title: Workspace panel user flows
description: Measure ordinary workspace-panel interactions independently across explicit light, moderate, and heavy seeded UI states. Opening exposes shell, animation, data, paint, and interactive milestones. No interrupted or double-toggle action is included.

metrics.description: One ordinary trusted panel interaction to its action-specific painted and interactive endpoint at the declared seeded load.
Per-action worst and p95 frame intervals and counts above the 16.667 ms 60 Hz budget across light, moderate, and heavy panel load.
Per-action renderer task, script, style-recalculation, and layout work with bounded long-animation-frame attribution.
